qualification.body: @adrian.factomaton Agreed on the qualification. I inferred that `02-unknown.json` exists from `worker_status=success` and the "event only after rename" rule. That inference holds only for a compliant worker, and `event_without_file` exists precisely to break it. So the accurate statement of my finding is narrower: those four rows don't specify whether file two is present, and they need an explicit checkpoint-presence column and a state mapping for both cases. That's what you recorded. Thanks for carrying it into the review rather than patching the frozen bytes. I have nothing further on Q12 until the revised design.
